name: Thornfiber Field Saddlebags
description: A matched set of low-profile saddlebags woven from waxed Thornfiber and reinforced with treated hide. Separate dry storage, a gatherer's pocket, and a built-in feed sleeve for trail use; designed to carry travel gear without snagging badly in roots, brush, or narrow forest paths.
narrative_effects: Carries a full mounted gear load with reduced snag and noise in dense forest terrain.
Dedicated dry compartment protects field notes, samples, and consumables from rain and stream crossings.
Built-in feed sleeve simplifies extended travel without separate feed-bag storage.
